title: Final Distance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the maximum distance r from the hole using the formula r = rho^2 / lambda.

title: Final Intensity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the intensity I' as I' = I_1 / 4.

title: Use of Fresnel Zones
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the relevance of the first Fresnel zone in determining the distance and intensity.

title: Correct Units
description: Important Criteria: The student must use appropriate units throughout the calculations, particularly for distance and wavelength.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of intensity and distance.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide clear intermediate steps leading to the final answers for clarity.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or implications of removing the opaque sheet.
